overview.title: Building a local packaging manufacturing base.
overview.subtitle: A phased manufacturing campus for pizza boxes, takeaway paper products and, subject to regulatory design, pharmaceutical packaging.
overview.description: A practical plan to turn packaging demand into local production capability, skilled work and a scalable industrial site.

highlights.label: Pizza boxes
highlights.desc: The first product line and the starting point for equipment validation.

highlights.label: Takeaway paper products
highlights.desc: A second paper-based line with shared upstream planning where practical.

highlights.label: Pharma packaging
highlights.desc: A later, separately assessed phase with stricter quality requirements.

overview.note: This is packaging-material manufacturing — not food production and not pharmaceutical production.

opportunity.title: From packaging demand to a local production ecosystem.

cards.title: A clear first step
cards.body: Start with pizza boxes: a defined product, a visible production story and a focused equipment-validation path.

cards.title: A broader campus
cards.body: Add takeaway packaging and integrate receiving, storage and dispatch where the operating model supports it.

cards.title: A controlled expansion
cards.body: Assess pharmaceutical packaging as a separate regulated phase rather than mixing unconfirmed requirements into phase one.

opportunity.callout: The project boundary is clear: manufacture packaging materials for food, catering and future regulated markets.

cards.title: Automation + people
cards.body: Machines handle repeatable, high-volume steps. People operate lines, change formats, inspect quality, maintain equipment and coordinate logistics.

cards.title: AI-assisted planning
cards.body: AI compares layouts, material flows, capacity scenarios and staffing assumptions. Final design remains subject to engineering and compliance approval.

campus.title: One coordinated campus, with the right separation.
campus.note: Shared logistics is an option for pizza and takeaway packaging. Pharma separation must be confirmed by regulatory and engineering review.

delivery.title: Use global equipment expertise. Build local operating capability.

phases.title: Phase 1
phases.body: Confirm product specification, machine configuration, supplier shortlist and site requirements.

phases.title: Phase 2
phases.body: Planning, detailed engineering, funding applications and equipment due diligence.

phases.title: Phase 3
phases.body: Construction, installation, commissioning, training and quality systems.

phases.title: Phase 4
phases.body: Ramp production, add product lines and assess pharmaceutical packaging separately.

cards.title: Supplier discipline
cards.body: Verify technical parameters, certifications, references, delivery capability and after-sales support before commitment.

cards.title: Local capability
cards.body: Employment grows around operations, maintenance, quality, warehousing, management and future technical development.

employment.title: Help us turn a credible plan into local jobs.
employment.jobsBody: Final job numbers depend on machine configuration, throughput and shift pattern. We will submit a measured baseline, operating case and expansion case — not an unsupported promise.
employment.callout: Decision needed: support a coordinated route to confirm site, planning, engineering assumptions and funding options.

close.quote: We are not asking government to approve an untested promise. We are asking for the coordination needed to validate and deliver a real packaging manufacturing project in Waterford.
close.leftBody: Confirm equipment data, site requirements, preliminary layout, supplier diligence and a defensible employment model.
close.rightBody: Agree the public-sector coordination pathway and the evidence required for the next stage.
close.source: Prepared from the ministerial meeting strategy and the packaging manufacturing discussion. Unconfirmed items are intentionally labelled as such.
